test_case_details.title: Test Case 2
test_case_details.custom_steps:
1. Trigger the workflow with an invalid or expired Jira API token. [Test Data: Invalid Jira API token] [Acceptance Criteria: 2]
2. Observe the error handling and user notification mechanisms. [Test Data: N/A] [Acceptance Criteria: 2]
3. Attempt recovery by providing a valid Jira API token. [Test Data: Valid Jira API token] [Acceptance Criteria: 2]

1. System detects authentication failure and logs the error.
2. User receives clear error message and guidance for re-authentication.
3. Workflow resumes successfully after re-authentication.
